items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: "You're going to lose my friendship if you do, 'cause I know you shouldn't do it."

ctx.x: look at the age now. Look at the age you've got -- more gullible now at that age than you would be at manhood, you know what I mean? Got to get caught. Got to get caught. What do you think Buck and Bubbles climbed from, huh? Climbed from being able to evade. We evaded all the possibilities of doing -- well, I won't go into that. Let you have that.

Once they asked for me -- Mae West, she asked for me at the Olympic Gardens when I went there to see Gorilla fight. She had her maid with her, sent the maid over to tell me that she wanted to see me. I says for what? She said, I don't know, she just wanted me to tell you she wanted to see you and if see don't get to see you she's gonna see Gorilla Jones. You tell her you better get Gorilla Jones for her. So they got Gorilla Jones, she went and got Gorilla Jones. So they made a date. But Gorilla Jones don't know…

me first.
Well, I was back in Gruman's
Chinese Theater when she drove up with her
chauffeur to have her secretary to come in and
ask for me playing at the Chinese Theater and
when they come to ask for me, I says, "What is
it?" Says, "Miss West wants to see you out in
the car." I said, "Buck, whistle for me, Miss
West is outside." Whistle for me when it's
time to go on. I go out to the car. She tells
the driver to take a walk and let me in. She
sat in the back seat. When I got in, she had
